headline:
Explosive growth,
thinner near-term margins
why_today: Closed up 2.5% today, extending a month where revenue growth has stayed strong even as margins came under pressure.
pro_1: Revenue growing nearly 50% year over year - among the fastest of any major internet retail company
pro_2: Price holding well above both its 50-day and 200-day averages, with strongly positive analyst sentiment
con_1: Earnings actually fell about 11% year over year despite the revenue surge - margins are under pressure
con_2: Valuation is rich at ~53x trailing earnings, leaving little room for disappointment
